welcome.title: Welcome to Trail!
welcome.description: Trail captures your browsing as living tree structures — every tab, every navigation, every detour. Instead of a flat history list, you get a map of how you actually explored the web.

install.title: Install the Extension
install.description: The Trail browser extension runs quietly in the background and records your navigation trees in real time. It takes about 30 seconds to install.

firstTrail.title: Your First Trail
firstTrail.description: Once the extension is installed, just browse normally. Every time you open a new tab or follow a link, Trail grows a new branch. Come back here to see your trails take shape.

done.title: You're all set!
done.description: Your account is ready. Head to the dashboard to see your trails, manage settings, and explore your browsing history like never before.

resetOnboarding.title: Reset onboarding
resetOnboarding.description: Clear the onboarding completion flag so it shows again on next login. Useful for testing.
